# Foreign terminology not used in branding

| No concept | Common Writing | Suggested alternative expression |
| --- | --- | --- |
| Low code | Low code, low code platform, low code development, low code code, Low Code, Low-Code, LowCode, LowCode, Low code, Low-code, Lowcode | Visualization configuration, flexible configuration, visualization set-up, process configuration on demand, no code development required (only when facts match) |
| SaaS | SAAS, SaaS, SaaS, SaaS, SaaS, Software as a Service, software as service | Cloud services, online enterprise services, cloud deployment programmes, subscription services (selected on a delivery basis) |
| PaaS | PAAS, PaaS, PaaS Platform, PaaS Service, Platform as a Service | Enterprise-level platform, application-building platform, development and operation of platform, platform capacity (selected on a functional basis) |

|  |
| --- |
| The above-mentioned English writing is not case-sensitive and includes spaces, hyphenation, underlineding and mixed form in Chinese and English. Where the relevant words appear in the original language of a third party, a statutory name or a historical quotation, their reference attributes should be clearly identified to avoid being understood as the brand itself. |
